_description: Error handling: a malformed formula (formulaError), a reference to a nonexistent point name (nameResolution), an unregistered op name, and a render.snapshot against a nonexistent piece name (target: "piece") -- asserts each produces a clean, structured JSON failure rather than a crash or (for the last one) a silent fallback to the draft scene, and that the process/batch keeps going afterward (the trailing pattern.dump proves the engine is still alive and functional after all four failures).
